messages:
maria: quick flag - linkcheck failing with weird broken anchors after the formatter run. anchors look fine in source but 404s on staging.
sam: example?
maria: guides/quickstart.md links to /reference/limits/#service–limits but staging shows 404 for /reference/limits/#service‑limits (there's a soft-hyphen or zwj somewhere).
toni: ugh, invisible unicode again. saw a ZWJ in a heading earlier; editors sometimes insert them when pasting from docs.
qa-bot: linkcheck report:
```
ERROR: 404 https://staging.redwood/reference/limits/#service%E2%80%8B%E2%80%91limits
WARN: Broken reference in 'guides/quickstart.md' -> 'reference/limits/#service–limits'
```
sam: short-term we can rewrite the link to match the encoded anchor but long-term we should normalize generated ids and run a repo scan.
toni: I'll prototype a small fixer script that strips zero-width and soft hyphen characters from headings before slugifying. snippet: 
```
import re
BAD = "\u200B\u200C\u200D\u00AD"
def clean(s):
    return re.sub(f"[{BAD}]", "", s)
```
I'll add unit tests for headings with ZWJ and soft hyphen.
maria: also add a diagnostic mode that lists files containing suspicious unicode so we can triage translations.
sam: create `tools/scan-gremlins.py --report` and `tools/regen-anchors --apply --redirects` would be good. redirect map can help during rollout.
toni: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pull/788 - includes clean(), scan script, tests, and a small redirect fixture consumed by the linkchecker.
buildbot: CI: linkcheck failed on branch fix/grem-788 - 2 remaining failures in ja locale. See https://ci.internal.redwood/3344
qa-bot: found 2 japanese headings with narrow no-break space; created report at /tmp/gremlins-report-3344.json
maria: i'll coordinate with i18n to fix source headings, but let's keep the redirect map for a week to avoid user-facing 404s. add note to MIGRATION.md to run `tools/scan-gremlins.py` after heavy editing.
sam: LGTM, left 1 tiny regex nit. once fixed, merge and run nightly.
buildbot: PR merged by sam. Nightly deploy started.
qa-bot: nightly linkcheck completed: all anchors resolved. created follow-up ticket DOCS-502 "gremlin sweep - remove redirects after source cleanup" and assigned to docs rotation.
maria: thanks team. added short SDK-snippet note for safe encoding: `encodeURIComponent(anchor)` and a reminder in the contributor guide about avoiding invisible characters when copy-pasting.
